{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "PROJECT BRIEF – STATIC EVENT WEBSITE IN ASTRO

Create a polished corporate-style static website for an environmental conference called “Global Green Infrastructure Summit 2026”. It should feel credible, institutional, and information-rich, like a modern corporate event site combined with the structured clarity of a Wikipedia article layout. Use Astro as the framework. This is a purely static front-end site only: no backend, no database, no login, no CMS, no real APIs. Use mock/static/sample content for all speakers, sessions, sponsors, statistics, news, and venue info.

GOAL
Build a professional event website for a 3-day sustainability / environment summit focused on climate adaptation, urban forests, water resilience, circular cities, and green infrastructure. The site should be suitable for government agencies, NGOs, corporate sustainability teams, universities, and urban planners.

STYLE
- Corporate, clean, trustworthy, premium but not flashy
- White / off-white background with deep forest green, slate gray, soft teal accents
- Use a structured editorial feel inspired by Wikipedia: clear sections, side info boxes, citations-style blocks, definition panels, timeline tables, glossary snippets
- Modern conference branding with subtle environmental patterns, leaf/grid lines, abstract topographic shapes
- Must be responsive: desktop, tablet, mobile
- Good spacing, strong typography, accessible contrast

TECH REQUIREMENTS
- Build with Astro
- Static pages/components only
- No external API calls
- No authentication, accounts, ticket checkout, admin, database, or server functions
- Use local/static JSON or inline arrays for mock data if needed
- Use CSS or minimal client-side JS only for UI interactions
- Include skeleton-loading effects: on initial page load, show skeleton cards/placeholders for agenda cards, speaker grid, sponsor logos, and resource list, then reveal the static content after a short simulated delay. This must not fetch real data.

SITE STRUCTURE / PAGES
1. Home
2. About the Summit
3. Agenda
4. Speakers
5. Venue & Travel
6. Sponsors / Partners
7. Resources
8. FAQ
9. Contact / Register Interest static form layout only, not functional

NAVIGATION
- Sticky header
- Logo text: GGIS 2026
- Menu: Home, About, Agenda, Speakers, Venue, Sponsors, Resources, FAQ
- CTA button: Register Interest
- Mobile hamburger menu
- Smooth scroll for homepage sections

HOME PAGE SECTIONS
HERO
- Title: “Global Green Infrastructure Summit 2026”
- Subtitle: “Building climate-resilient cities through nature-based solutions.”
- Date: 18–20 September 2026
- Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
- CTAs: View Agenda, Explore Speakers
- Include a corporate event badge: “International Environmental Forum”
- Add small stats: 3 Days, 48 Sessions, 80+ Speakers, 35 Countries

TRUST BAR
- Mock partner names: Nordic Climate Council, Urban Nature Alliance, Institute for Circular Cities, Green Ports Forum, European Water Resilience Network
- Sponsor/partner logos can be text-based placeholders in styled cards

ABOUT PREVIEW
- Explain the event mission
- Include a Wikipedia-like “At a glance” side infobox with:
  Event type, Theme, Frequency, Founded, Host city, Main topics, Audience

FEATURED THEMES
Cards:
- Urban Forests & Biodiversity
- Sponge Cities & Water Resilience
- Low-Carbon Infrastructure
- Circular Construction
- Coastal Adaptation
- Environmental Finance
Each card should include icon placeholder, title, short description, and small tag.

AGENDA PREVIEW
- Show 3-day tabbed agenda preview or static tabs
- Include skeleton loading before agenda cards appear
- Each session card: time, track, title, room, speaker names, difficulty/level tag

SPEAKER PREVIEW
- Grid of featured speakers with mock portraits using gradients/initials, no external images required
- Skeleton loading cards before reveal
- Include job titles and organization names

WIKIPEDIA-INSPIRED KNOWLEDGE SECTION
Create an editorial section titled “Context: What is green infrastructure?”
- Use encyclopedia-style layout with a mini table of contents on the side
- Include definition, history, benefits, controversies/challenges, related concepts
- Add fake citation markers like [1], [2], [3] visually, but no real links required
- Add a right-side infobox with key terms

COUNTDOWN / EVENT INFO
- Static-looking countdown component is okay but no backend. If easier, use fixed numbers or client-side date calculation only.
- Include venue, date, language, expected attendance

NEWS / ANNOUNCEMENTS
- Static announcement cards:
  “Call for poster sessions now open”
  “Municipal climate labs announced”
  “New circular procurement track added”

FOOTER
- Corporate footer with quick links, mock address, email text, social link placeholders
- Add note: “Static demonstration website — sample content.”

ABOUT PAGE
Sections:
- Mission
- Why green infrastructure matters
- Summit objectives
- Who should attend
- Organizing committee mock list
- Event history timeline from 2021 to 2026
- Wikipedia-style contents box and infobox

AGENDA PAGE
Complex detailed schedule for 3 days.
- Filters UI visually for Track / Day / Session Type, but static or client-side only
- Tracks: Policy, Science, Finance, Cities, Infrastructure, Community
- Include at least 18 mock sessions total
- Each session card has: time, title, track, format, room, speakers, summary
- Skeleton loading simulation on first render
- Include downloadable-looking buttons but no real downloads required

SPEAKERS PAGE
- At least 16 mock speakers
- Corporate profile cards
- Category filters visually or client-side only: Keynote, Panelist, Workshop Lead, Moderator
- Speaker detail modal or expandable profile is okay using front-end only
- Include organization, country, topic expertise, short bio
- Skeleton loading before speaker grid reveals

VENUE PAGE
- Venue: Nordic Convention Centre, Copenhagen
- Include static map placeholder (not Google Maps, no real embeds)
- Travel cards: airport, train, public transit, cycling, accessibility
- Hotel suggestions as static cards
- Sustainability notes: low-waste venue, plant-based catering, public transit pass, reusable badge policy

SPONSORS PAGE
- Sponsor tiers: Strategic Partners, Gold Sponsors, Knowledge Partners, Media Partners
- Static logo cards
- Include sponsorship benefits table
- Include CTA section
- Skeleton loading for logo grid

RESOURCES PAGE
- Static resource library with cards
- Types: briefing paper, checklist, city case study, glossary, policy note
- Include search input visual only or client-side filter only, no backend
- Include Wikipedia-inspired glossary section with terms:
  Nature-based solutions, Blue-green corridors, Permeable surfaces, Heat island mitigation, Carbon sequestration, Ecological connectivity
- Skeleton loading for resources

FAQ PAGE
Accordion style FAQ using front-end only.
Questions about attendance, language, accessibility, sustainability, poster sessions, certificates, travel, media.

CONTACT / REGISTER INTEREST PAGE
- Static form layout only, no submission backend
- Fields: name, organization, email, role, interest area, message
- On click submit, show a front-end-only success message like “Thank you — this demo form does not send data.”
- Include contact cards and office hours

COMPONENTS TO CREATE
- Header
- Footer
- Hero
- SectionHeading
- StatCard
- InfoBox / WikipediaStyleInfobox
- TableOfContents
- ThemeCard
- AgendaCard
- SpeakerCard
- SponsorLogoCard
- ResourceCard
- SkeletonCard / SkeletonGrid
- FAQAccordion
- StaticMapPlaceholder
- Timeline

INTERACTIONS
- Skeleton loading simulation for agenda, speakers, sponsors, resources
- Mobile nav open/close
- FAQ accordions
- Optional client-side filters for agenda/resources/speakers using local static data only
- Smooth anchor scrolling
- No API calls

ACCESSIBILITY
- Semantic HTML
- Keyboard-friendly navigation
- Visible focus states
- ARIA labels where appropriate
- Good color contrast
- Reduced motion support for animations/skeleton shimmer

DELIVERABLE
A complete Astro static website with clean components, mock content, and polished responsive design. It should run locally and build as a static site without external services. Make it look like a real corporate environmental event website, not a placeholder template.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.
